title: Robot Clickin
tagline: Robot Clickin is an AI AB Testing Platform. It uses Blockchain to revolutionize AB Testing. The idea it to make reporting on issues on the UI/UX easy
description: Robot Clickin is a platform for AB and QA Testing powered by Blockchain and Artificial Intelligence. The idea is to make reporting on issues on the UI/UX easy using Blockchain and AI. On this platform AI automations can be scripted to tests for specific UI elements, those analytics are then stored on chain.
how_its_made: Made leveraging libraries and SDKs provided by Nethermind, Coinbase Agent Kit, and LIT AI Agent Wallet. The idea is to make reporting on issues on the UI/UX easy using Blockchain and AI. On this platform AI automations can be scripted to tests for specific UI elements, those analytics are then stored on chain.
